incidents.description: Highway 5, in both directions. Bridge maintenance planned at Clemina Overhead Bridge (29 km south of Valemount). Starting Thu Sep 24 at 8:00 AM PDT until Thu Sep 24 at 4:00 PM PDT. Single lane alternating traffic will be in effect. Watch for traffic control personnel. Last updated Wed Sep 23 at 9:01 PM PDT. (DBC-94232)

Utility work at Highway 99, between Highway 97 intersection and Hat Creek Road. Starting Mon Sep 21 until Fri Sep 25. From 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM PDT, weekdays. Single lane alternating traffic. Watch for traffic control. Last update: September 16th, 2026 at 11:00am PDT.

Construction work at Highway 29, Upper Cache Rd. Starting Mon Aug 31 until Fri Oct 30. From 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM MST, weekdays. Reduced to one lane. Watch for traffic control. Last update: September 15th, 2026 at 8:12pm MST.

Bridge maintenance at Highway 97, In NRRM and At Adsett Creek Bridge. Starting Wed Sep 2 until Thu Oct 15. Single lane alternating traffic. Watch for traffic control. Last update: September 15th, 2026 at 8:12pm MST.

Utility work at Highway 29, At Cache Creek Bridge and 33km West of Fort St John. Starting Mon Aug 24 until Wed Sep 30. From 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM MST, every day. Single lane alternating traffic. Watch for traffic control. Expect minor delays. Last update: September 15th, 2026 at 8:11pm MST. Speed reduced to 50km/h at work site.

Road maintenance at Highway 29, 2km Northeast of Cache Creek Bridge. Starting Mon Sep 14 until Fri Sep 25. From 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM MST, weekdays. Single lane alternating traffic. Speed Limit restriction: 30. Last update: September 15th, 2026 at 8:11pm MST.

Construction work at Quesnel-Hydraulic Road, 25km Southeast of Quesnel. Starting Wed Jul 22 until Thu Dec 31. Single lane alternating traffic. Watch for traffic control. Expect minor delays. Last update: September 15th, 2026 at 8:10pm PDT.

Construction work at Highway 97, 34km North of Quesnel and Olsen Rd intersection. Starting Mon Aug 17 until Fri Oct 16. From 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM PDT, Monday to Saturday. Last update: September 15th, 2026 at 8:10pm PDT. Intersection improvements. Intermittent lane closures in both directions. Speed reduction in place. Watch for traffic control.

Bridge maintenance at Chilko-Newton Road, Chilko River Siwash Bridge. Starting Mon Jul 13. Expect delays. Weight vehicle restriction: 32,000KG. Last update: September 15th, 2026 at 8:09pm PDT. Next update time Mon Oct 26.

Electrical maintenance at Horse Lake Road, In 100 Mile House and At Birch Ave and Cariboo Trail and Horse Lake Rd. Starting Fri Jul 10. Last update: September 15th, 2026 at 8:09pm PDT. Installation of new traffic signal. Watch for traffic control at intersection. Expect short holds to traffic during pole installation.

Bridge maintenance at Lillooet-Pioneer Road, Tyaughton Creek Bridge. Starting Mon Jun 15 until Wed Sep 30. Single lane alternating traffic. Watch for traffic control. Last update: September 15th, 2026 at 8:09pm PDT. Maximum clearance width 3.18m. Oversized loads wider than 3.18m use alternate route. Expect minor delays of up to 10 minutes.

Rock scaling at Mission Mountain Road, Terzaghi Dam. Starting Tue Aug 4 until Wed Sep 30. From 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM PDT, every day. Single lane alternating traffic. Watch for traffic control. Last update: September 15th, 2026 at 8:08pm PDT. Scaling above bridge deck. Expect minor delays of up to 20 minutes. Work will be intermittent.

Rest area closed at Highway 1, Redgrave Rest Area. Starting Tue Jul 14. Last update: September 15th, 2026 at 9:06pm MDT. Redgrave rest area is permanently closed. New rest area will be built just west of the current location. Stay tuned for more updates as construction progresses.

Washrooms closed at Highway 1, In Revelstoke and at Revelstoke Rest Area. Until Sat Oct 31. Watch for traffic control. Last update: September 15th, 2026 at 8:06pm PDT. The Revelstoke Rest Area will be closed due to highway upgrades in the area. Nearby rest areas remaining open: Illecillewaet Break check - Commercial and passenger, Rutherford rest area  - Passenger, Shelter Bay rest area - Passenger and The Last Spike rest area - commercial and passenger.

Construction work at River Road, In Delta and Exit 29  - River Rd. Starting Tue Sep 8 until Thu Oct 1. From 10:00 PM to 1:00 PM PDT the next day, every day. Exit ramp closed. Last update: September 2nd, 2026 at 3:55pm PDT.

Utility work at Weigh Scale Road, In Delta and At Weigh Scale Road and turning lane. Starting Mon Sep 21 until Sat Sep 26. From 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM PDT, Monday to Saturday. Right turn lane closed. Last update: September 2nd, 2026 at 11:48am PDT.

Bridge closed at Johnston Bridge Loop, In Quesnel and Front St. Last update: August 26th, 2026 at 9:29am PDT. Next update: October 19th, 2026 at 9:00am PDT. Industrial traffic and heavy commercial traffic must detour via Plywood Rd and Maple Drive. Industrial traffic is not allowed to detour through Johnston Subdivision.

Highway 16 (Yellowhead Highway). Bridge maintenance between Grant Brook Bridge and Fraser River West Bridge (10 km east of Moose Lake). From 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM PDT on Monday, Tuesday and Thursday. Single lane alternating traffic. Last updated Mon Aug 24 at 8:51 AM PDT. (DBC-94048)
